labels.rationale: Upstream Django Storage.save delegated name selection to get_available_name and validated the returned name only after the file had already been written, so a storage backend that overrides get_available_name, or an incoming name that the selection step returns unchanged, could carry a traversal component into the write path before any validation ran. Fixed upstream in Django 5.0.7 by validating the name both before and after get_available_name (CVE-2024-39330). Provenance: upstream diff django/core/files/storage/base.py 5.0.6 -> 5.0.7.

Upstream Django Urlizer.trim_punctuation rescanned the whole word for every wrapping punctuation pair and for every trailing character, with no memoization of per-character counts, so cost grew with the square of the token length and a crafted input string stalled the conversion. Fixed upstream in Django 5.0.7 by memoizing per-word character counts and hoisting the punctuation sets into cached properties (CVE-2024-38875). Provenance: upstream diff django/utils/html.py 5.0.6 -> 5.0.7.
